newsitem.title: USA: U.S. power output rises 0.1 pct vs. year ago -- EEI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. power output rises 0.1 pct vs. year ago -- EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 59,387 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended March 15, up 0.1 percent from the same period in 1996, Edison Electric Institute (EEI) said Wednesday.
The amount of weekly power supplied to the Pacific Southwestarea showed the largest year-to-year rise, up 7.7 percent to 4,644 GWh, EEI said.
The Southeast region experienced the sharpest decrease in power output, falling 7.3 percent from the corresponding period a year earlier to 13,799 GWh.
Year-to-date domestic power production for the first 11 weeks of 1997 totaled 698,758 GWh, virtually unchanged from the same period in 1996.
